thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Elevated 5xx and P99 tail latency on inference-runtime-prod (us-west-2). Error budget crossing threshold. Affected route: /v1/generate (model: redwood-7b-q4). Alerting: latency > 1200ms p99 and 5xx rate 6% for last 3m. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/incidents/1872509876

anya (oncall): seeing the same in the dashboard. High queue depth on the renderer behind runtime. First priority: reduce incoming load to protect control plane and prevent cascading oom.

matt (sre): agree. Propose staged mitigations: 1) global soft-rate-limit on /v1/generate -> 700rps, 2) reduce max_in_flight on runtime pool from 800 -> 300, 3) enable shedding for low-priority keys (anonymous/unauthed), 4) bump upstream timeout to 20s for long tails. I'll run 1+2 now.

sara (eng-runtime): quick note — reducing max_in_flight will cause some requests to queue longer; we should enable client-facing 429s for excess immediately. Also we have a config flag to drop 'streaming-chunk' requests if queue > 80% which saves memory.

matt (sre): executing step 1: `rictl policy set-rate --route /v1/generate --limit 700`
ops-bot: Rate limit policy applied: /v1/generate -> 700rps. Rule id: rl-20260315-01.

matt (sre): executing step 2: `rictl runtime set-max-inflight --pool prod-renderers --value 300`
ops-bot: max_in_flight updated for pool prod-renderers -> 300. Rolling config to 6 nodes.

anya (oncall): seeing immediate drop in 5xxs from 6% -> 3.2% but p99 still high ~900ms. Queue depth decreased but some long-running requests remain stuck.

sara (eng-runtime): enabling shedding for anonymous keys: `rictl controller enable-shedding --label anonymous --threshold 75`
ops-bot: Shedding rule enabled for anonymous label at 75% queue.

matt (sre): also enabling early timeout for streaming chunks: `rictl route set-timeout --route /v1/generate --timeout 20s`
ops-bot: Route timeout updated for /v1/generate -> 20s.

anya (oncall): support is getting customer reports. @lucy can you triage top customers with errors and see if any are enterprise (dedicated) so we can apply targeted fixes?

lucy (support-esc): on it. Pulling top 10 erroring API keys... two customers with high volume: acct-A (standard) and acct-E (trial). No dedicated customers impacted. Reached out to acct-A with temporary quota reduction guidance and apology.

josh (product): hold off on quota reduction for acct-A unless they request it. If it's our side, we should act globally first. Can we offer them a quieter window or route them to a canary model variant with lower resource usage?

sara (eng-runtime): we have a compatible cheaper variant redwood-7b-q4f (lower kv cache pressure). We can route a subset of their traffic to it as a fallback. Command: `rictl routing set-fallback --customer acct-A --from redwood-7b-q4 --to redwood-7b-q4f --pct 30`

matt (sre): applied fallback 30% for acct-A.
ops-bot: Routing fallback applied for acct-A: 30% -> redwood-7b-q4f.

anya (oncall): realtime metrics: 5xx down to 1.1%, p99 ~520ms and trending down. Good. Need to monitor for at least 15m before relaxing limits.

josh (product): notify customer success with the fallback action and ETA for stabilization. I'll draft a note.

lucy (support-esc): pinged CS, they've messaged acct-A with an update and offered a temporary traffic window.

sara (eng-runtime): follow-up optimization: enable prefix KV cache hot-path for redwood-7b-q4 to reduce recompute for similar prompts — low-risk toggle. `rictl model toggle-kv-cache-hotpath --model redwood-7b-q4 --on`

ops-bot: KV cache hot-path enabled for redwood-7b-q4 on prod-renderers.

matt (sre): after cache toggle, p99 380ms, 5xx stable at 0.3%. Starting to revert hard mitigations: increase max_in_flight back to 500 (not full 800), keep rate limit at 700 for another 10m.

anya (oncall): I'm going to hand off in 10m to @matt (next oncall). Will keep the page open until metrics stable for 15m.

matt (sre): taking over. I'll watch the runbook checklist. Next actions if we regress: 1) push zero-downtime autoscale to add two more rendering pods, 2) if memory thrash observed, roll model variant down to q3 quantization for some nodes.

sara (eng-runtime): note on autoscale — scaling takes ~120s to warm; prefer traffic shaping for immediate protection.

josh (product): postmortem needed with timeline + customer impact and which mitigations helped. Assigning follow-up to eng-runtime + SRE.

anya (oncall): recording timeline to incident doc: https://docs.internal/incidents/1872509876-postmortem (I'll fill in). Will include command snippets and decision rationale.

lucy (support-esc): no major customer escalations after fallback. acct-A accepted fallback and said they're ok with temporary performance drop.

ops-bot: Incident alert auto-note: mitigation applied -> rate-limit + max_in_flight reduction + shedding + fallback routing + kv-cache toggle. Monitoring for 30m.

matt (sre): closing active page for now. Leave incident open until postmortem. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
